tailoring.headline: Product Owner & SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | E-Commerce Platforms & Integrations
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional professional with 5+ years of experience shaping enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Proven expertise managing product backlogs, translating business objectives into user stories and acceptance criteria, and collaborating with international Scrum teams. Hands-on with SAP Commerce Cloud, OCC REST APIs, data pipelines, and Agile delivery. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Product Owner (m/f/x)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Product Owner position at Carhartt WIP in Berlin. With over 5 years of enterprise e-commerce experience building and shaping platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring a robust techno-functional background bridging business objectives and agile technical delivery.

bullets.label: Backlog & Requirements
bullets.text: I have extensive experience working in a techno-functional capacity with business stakeholders to analyse requirements, write user stories, define functional specifications, and translate business goals into SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Agile Collaboration
bullets.text: Working closely with international Scrum teams, I have successfully driven the discovery and implementation of platform enhancements, ensuring requirements are clearly defined and technical dependencies are effectively managed.

bullets.label: E-Commerce Customer Journeys
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have directly contributed to optimizing end-to-end shopping experiences across product catalogs, pricing, promotions, and order management systems.

bullets.label: Integrations & Technical Coordination
bullets.text: I bring a solid technical understanding of web platforms, coordinating complex API integrations, headless commerce architectures, and third-party data pipelines across global channels.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving my notice period with a final working day on 15 December 2026, and I am available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with Carhartt WIP.

tailoring.why_company: Carhartt WIP represents an iconic blend of authentic heritage and modern European street culture, operating a dynamic digital ecosystem that demands both strong customer focus and deep technical precision. Bringing over five years of enterprise e-commerce experience from Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to help shape the ongoing evolution of the Carhartt WIP European webshop by translating business goals into seamless digital experiences.
tailoring.motivation_short: With 5+ years of e-commerce experience bridging business needs and agile development, I bring strong backlog management, user story creation, and technical integration expertise to Carhartt WIP.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I am very excited about the Product Owner role at Carhartt WIP. With 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce experience managing requirements, user stories, and agile delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I would love to connect and discuss how I can contribute.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Product Owner - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Product Owner position at Carhartt WIP in Berlin.

With over 5 years of professional experience in enterprise e-commerce, user story creation, backlog management, and stakeholder alignment at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-prepared to support your agile Scrum team in enhancing the European webshop.

I am based in Germany with a valid work permit and am available from 16 December 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
